First, I'll parse the SVG path data to identify the vertices and their connections.

The path commands:
- M 68.30,63.99 (move to starting point)
- L 51.75,56.30 (line to)
- L 54.65,45.37 (line to)
- L 44.78,49.20 (line to)
- M 44.78,49.20 (move to same point - this creates a discontinuity)
- L 53.45,29.00 (line to)
- L 58.01,38.91 (line to)
- L 72.03,39.79 (line to)
- L 68.30,63.99 (line back to start)

Counting the distinct line segments:
1. 68.30,63.99 → 51.75,56.30
2. 51.75,56.30 → 54.65,45.37
3. 54.65,45.37 → 44.78,49.20
4. 44.78,49.20 → 53.45,29.00
5. 53.45,29.00 → 58.01,38.91
6. 58.01,38.91 → 72.03,39.79
7. 72.03,39.79 → 68.30,63.99

This forms a closed shape with 7 sides. A polygon with 7 sides is a heptagon.

Final answer: (B)
